links.outcome: AI performance when applied to oncology patients outside its intended DR/ARMD/glaucoma screening population
links.effect: Eight patients with leukemic retinopathy were incorrectly flagged as having DR; optic atrophy was not detected; AI correct for glaucoma (3), DR (2), ARMD (2).
links.quote: However, eight patients with leukemic retinopathy were incorrectly flagged as having DR, revealing a lack of specificity in distinguishing vascular retinal pathologies.

screen.reason: Prospective observational evaluation of an existing commercial diagnostic AI (Medios AI) deployed in an ocular oncology clinic to assess diagnostic concordance and safety blind spots in a specialized patient cohort, but it does not compare outcomes with/without a deployment guardrail.
